question: Which units are vacant right now?
gold_sql: SELECT u.unit_id, b.name AS building, u.unit_number FROM unit u JOIN building b ON b.building_id=u.building_id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lease l JOIN lease_status s ON s.status_id=l.status_id WHERE l.unit_id=u.unit_id AND s.is_current=1)

question: List tenants who currently have a lease, with their unit and monthly rent.
gold_sql: SELECT t.first_name, t.last_name, u.unit_number, u.monthly_rent FROM lease l JOIN lease_status s ON s.status_id=l.status_id JOIN tenant t ON t.tenant_id=l.tenant_id JOIN unit u ON u.unit_id=l.unit_id WHERE s.is_current=1

question: How many maintenance requests are still open in each building?
gold_sql: SELECT b.name, COUNT(*) FROM maintenance m JOIN unit u ON u.unit_id=m.unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id=u.building_id WHERE m.state <> 'closed' GROUP BY b.name

question: Which tenants paid rent late at least once in 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.first_name, t.last_name FROM payment p JOIN lease l ON l.lease_id=p.lease_id JOIN tenant t ON t.tenant_id=l.tenant_id WHERE p.paid_on > p.due_on AND p.due_on >= '2026-01-01'

question: Total rent collected per region in 2026.
gold_sql: SELECT r.name, SUM(p.amount) FROM payment p JOIN lease l ON l.lease_id=p.lease_id JOIN unit u ON u.unit_id=l.unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id=u.building_id JOIN region r ON r.region_id=b.region_id WHERE p.paid_on >= '2026-01-01' AND p.paid_on < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY r.name

question: Urgent maintenance requests that are not closed, with the technician assigned.
gold_sql: SELECT m.request_id, m.category, s.first_name, s.last_name FROM maintenance m LEFT JOIN staff s ON s.staff_id=m.assigned_to WHERE m.priority='urgent' AND m.state <> 'closed'

question: Average number of days to close a plumbing request.
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(julianday(closed) - julianday(opened)) FROM maintenance WHERE category='plumbing' AND closed IS NOT NULL

question: Leases ending between 2026-10-01 and 2026-12-31.
gold_sql: SELECT l.lease_id, t.first_name, t.last_name, l.end_date FROM lease l JOIN tenant t ON t.tenant_id=l.tenant_id WHERE l.end_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-12-31'

question: Which buildings have an elevator and more than 10 units?
gold_sql: SELECT b.name FROM building b JOIN unit u ON u.building_id=b.building_id WHERE b.has_elevator=1 GROUP BY b.building_id, b.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 10

question: Evicted tenants and their email addresses.
gold_sql: SELECT t.first_name, t.last_name, t.email FROM lease l JOIN lease_status s ON s.status_id=l.status_id JOIN tenant t ON t.tenant_id=l.tenant_id WHERE s.label='Evicted'

question: How many plumbin requests are waiting_part?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM maintenance WHERE category='plumbing' AND state='waiting_parts'

question: Show open electricle maintenance requests with their unit.
gold_sql: SELECT m.request_id, u.unit_number, m.opened FROM maintenance m JOIN unit u ON u.unit_id=m.unit_id WHERE m.category='electrical' AND m.state='open'
